decisions.finding: MacRumors and OS X Daily independently preserve the public audience, sequence, and Pacific appearance date for the complete Yosemite public-beta sequence.
MacRumors and OS X Daily independently preserve the public audience, sequence, and Pacific appearance date for the first four El Capitan public betas.
The retained MacRumors evidence plus independent OS X Daily, iDownloadBlog, MacMagazine, or Macworld evidence supports all seven Sierra identities and dates.
MacRumors and iCulture's candidate-specific prose independently support the seven High Sierra identities and dates.
decisions.requiredQualification: Do not use iCulture's typo-prone recap list for Public Beta 1 or Public Beta 7. Its dated prose sections say June 29 and August 28 and agree with MacRumors.

decisions.finding: MacRumors and iCulture support Public Betas 1 through 7. Softpedia's August 27 update and the August 28 JST technical record independently support Public Beta 8.
decisions.requiredQualification: Normalize the Public Beta 8 appearance to August 27 in America/Los_Angeles; the August 28 Monomaniac date is the Japanese local calendar date.

decisions.finding: MacRumors and iCulture support Public Betas 1 through 4 and 6. Public Beta 2 and Public Beta 6 use the Pacific appearance date rather than iCulture's following-day European calendar date.
decisions.requiredQualification: Keep Public Beta 2 at July 3 and Public Beta 6 at August 28 under the packet's America/Los_Angeles convention.

decisions.finding: The proposed August 20 date conflicts with the packet's Pacific-date convention. The retained MacRumors article was updated for public availability on August 19, and its discussion records availability at 10:23 a.m. PDT that day. iCulture's August 20 08:32 CEST revision is August 19 23:32 PDT.

caveats.subject: seven unresolved candidates
caveats.finding: El Capitan Public Beta 5 has a same-label withdrawal/replacement conflict, and six late-cycle candidates still lack the required editorial corroboration or conflict resolution.
caveats.requiredHandling: Keep these seven candidates out of a promotion queue until the packet's existing evidence and modeling blockers are resolved.

caveats.subject: unnumbered OS X 10.9.3 program origin
caveats.finding: The April 22, 2014 open Beta Seed Program appearance is historically supported but is not truthfully representable as Public Beta 1, and production has no 10.9.3 release-version parent.
caveats.requiredHandling: Require a separate version-parent and unnumbered-appearance modeling decision; do not create a numbered beta.

caveats.subject: source-claim precision
caveats.finding: Several developer-seed articles were later updated only to say that a new public beta was available; the independent companion source supplies the explicit public ordinal.
caveats.requiredHandling: At publication, cite each source only for the fields its text actually states. Do not describe a generic public-availability update as literal-ordinal evidence.

caveats.subject: production snapshot age
caveats.finding: The zero-match production reconciliation is a time-bounded read-only snapshot.
caveats.requiredHandling: Repeat the exact identity query immediately before any separately authorized Sanity write.

authorization.chronologyApprovalScope: Public-beta appearance identity, date, sequence, and channel only; all qualifications remain mandatory.
